label: pregabalin 75 mg oral twice 12 h apart (Lyrica), fasted, n=8 men, 1-4 h after the second dose
statistic: arithmetic mean computed from the 8 printed individual values
note: Tujii T et al. Int J Gen Med 2014;7:103-108, Table 1 (PMC3912019). SUSPECT SOURCE, verified=false: the transcription is exact, but (1) the paper prints individual values only, so the means are computed; (2) times are inferred as 12 h + the printed '1-4 h after the second dose'; (3) its 'Baseline (prior to first dose)' column reads 0.86-1.32 ug/mL, impossible before any dose, so it is left out; (4) every value is about twice what Pfizer's own Japanese data imply (PMDA CTD 2.7.6: 150 mg Cmax 5.07 ug/mL). A miss on this curve is not evidence against the preset without a second source. Assay and LLOQ not described. Mean weight 69 kg.
